jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Research Scientist
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. PhD in machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer science, statistics, applied mathematics, biomedical engineering, or a related quantitative discipline Minimum 5 years of professional or research experience with a strong research track record (high-quality peer-reviewed publications including leading conferences such as NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML) Deep expertise in one or more areas such as foundation models, large language model reasoning, multimodal learning, causal machine learning, digital twins, probabilistic modeling, uncertainty quantification, or sequential decision-making

jobs.title: Principal Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or a related quantitative discipline Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in AI engineering, machine learning, natural language processing, or development of AI-enabled applications Hands-on experience developing applications using large language models, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic AI approaches

jobs.title: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or related technical discipline Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in full-stack or backend software engineering, including rapid prototyping and production-grade applications Ability to translate ambiguous user needs into functioning software prototypes and evolve them into robust, maintainable solutions

jobs.description: Students And Graduates I EMD Group STUDENTS & GRADUATES Ready to explore, break barriers, and enter the world of science and technology? Work your magic with us. EXPLORE, DISCOVER, & START YOUR CAREER WITH US! We know you got big plans – and so do we! Together, our colleagues around the world are pushing the boundaries of science and technology to improve the lives of patients worldwide. Become one of our curious minds and help us answer tomorrow’s questions. Work your magic in one of our graduate programs, or apply directly for an entry-level position. Gain valuable experience in an international environment that promotes personal growth and development while expanding your network. We welcome students from all levels of the academic journey – delve deeper and bring your ideas to life or collaborate with us on your thesis! FACTS & FIGURES 350+ YEARS of expertise. 62.500+ COLLEAGUES around the world. 3 BUSINESSES in Healthcare, Life Science & Electronics. ​​​​​​​ GRADUATE PROGRAMS Explore our business and discover your strengths with our customized graduate programs. Together, we push the boundaries of science and technology to make more possible! You will remain an employee of Randstad at all times, and Randstad will be solely responsible for managing your employment, as well as for providing benefits (if any), making wage payments and tax withholdings. Career Opportunities in Inhouse Consulting WHAT WE OFFER Talent Development + Business Consulting We attract, develop, and place high potentials from the external market, providing valuable talents. Our internal clients appreciate us as trusted partner thanks to our tailored and impactful business consulting. Inside Inhouse Consulting: What our consultants say Watch the video Close the popup Loading... WHO WE ARE MEET SOME OF OUR CONSULTANTS How do you spend your time outside of work? Outside of work, I spend as much time as possible with my family and my two daughters particularly. When there’s time left, I enjoy spending time with friends or doing sports such as playing football, cycling, running or hiking. I also tend to never say no to a good espresso. Read more Raphael Kuhlmann Darmstadt Office What is your role in your projects? As the project lead, my role involves orchestrating efforts among the client team, cross-functional stakeholders, and the IC team to ensure we meet our project objectives. Both projects share common elements, necessitating collaboration with diverse subject matter experts to gather inputs that inform IC analysis and final recommendations. In addition to overseeing client deliverables, I am also committed to coaching and mentoring the associates involved in these projects. Read more Shruthi Balasuryan Boston Office What did you do before you joined IC? I reinvented my career when making the decision to enter the consulting world in the area of transaction and M&A, following the completion of my PhD in polymer chemistry. Read more Beatriz Pineda Darmstadt Office Which projects are you working on? I have a preference for engaging in projects that center around digitalization and transformation. One illustrative experience includes Data Office, where I played a pivotal role in shaping the operational framework and defining forthcoming data-related positions. Read more Adelina Haziri Darmstadt Office What do you like most about your job? Within IC, I work with highly capable, and collaborative colleagues, in delivering engagements. Clients come to us with their most challenging issues, and I find process of working together to achieve a strong project outcome highly rewarding. Read more Daniel Thia Singapore Office MEET SOME OF OUR GRADUATES Ready to take the next step in your career? Learn more about our Inhouse Consulting GoGlobal Program Why did you choose the global graduate program? I chose the global graduate program because I see it as a fantastic opportunity to explore various sectors and business units within the company. This rotational experience allows me to acquire invaluable skills in consulting while discovering the field that truly resonates with my passions and career aspirations. This dynamic environment not only enriches my professional journey but also creates a supportive atmosphere where collaboration thrives. I am excited about the potential for personal growth and the chance to shape my future career path within such an innovative organization. Read more Marianna Bokou Darmstadt Office What is your background? I hold a PhD in Biology from MIT, where my thesis focused on the molecular genetics underlying cell stress signaling. Prior to graduate school, I was a healthcare consultant focusing on pricing and market access dynamics in the US pharmaceutical and medical technology space. I also hold undergraduate degrees in Molecular Biophysics & Biochemistry and History. Read more Acer Xu Boston Office Which projects are you working on? Within the first 6 months of joining the Inhouse Consulting GOglobal Graduate Program, I had the opportunity to support a wide range of projects across multiple sectors. My contributions include supporting strategic launch decisions for a life-saving medicine and developing a health equity center of excellence within the Healthcare sector, developing strategic growth plans for high-quality laboratory materials and research solutions in the Life Science sector, conducting capacity reviews for the Electronics sector, and performing capability mapping of the company’s IT hub. Read more Gigi Huang Singapore Office What is your role in your projects? My role in the projects include managing stakeholders, facilitating meetings, and organizing and driving written communications. I am also responsible for slide ideation and creation, data analysis and interpretation, and developing various client-facing deliverables. Through these responsibilities, I have been applying and further developing key skills such as effective communication, problem-solving, critical thinking, and proactive project management. As more junior colleagues join the team, such as interns, I have also been building my leadership skills by guiding and supporting their work. Read more Carolina Vasconcellos Darmstadt Office How do you spend your time outside of work? Being a very active person, I enjoy playing basketball, going to the gym, and traveling the world. Meeting my friends, exploring new cultures, and meeting new people is very important to me, which is also why I enjoy the international setup and focus of the program so much. Read more Felix Jäger Darmsta

jobs.description: Benefits I EMD Group BENEFITS To us a good job is not just about money. In addition to competitive compensation and bonuses acknowledging outstanding work, we also offer a wide range of benefits to everyone working at our company. OUR EMPLOYEES MAKE US WHO WE ARE At Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, our employees make us who we are. We strive to be an innovative company that goes above and beyond to attract the brightest and boldest talent we need to reach our business goals. Above all, we care about the health and well-being of our employees and their loved ones. When you choose an employer, we know you will consider your full Total Rewards picture—not just how much money you’ll make or what your job responsibilities will be. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits program that goes far beyond the basics—and offers something for everyone across any life stage and personal situation. Whether it’s growing your family, caring for loved ones, building your future, or handling a major life change, we’re here to help you live your best life. Your journey is unique, and we pride ourselves on offering the most generous, highest quality benefit programs among our peers to support that journey. Our benefits offering encompasses four pillars of holistic well-being to include: health and wellness; saving and financial; voluntary benefits; and work/life support. As curious minds, we care, pioneer, and outperform to advance human progress for our customers and patients. See below how our benefits can do the same for you. Health & Wellness We offer comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage—including virtual care through Telehealth and free behavioral health counseling sessions. We also offer a wellness incentive program and personalized support to help you navigate and use your benefits. Saving & Financial Our 401(k) Plan includes a generous company-matching contribution and an additional discretionary contribution each year. We also provide tax-advantaged accounts for you to save for healthcare, commuting expenses, company-provided and buy-up life insurance to help you protect your financial future. Voluntary Benefits Our voluntary benefits provide additional protection from the high costs of healthcare not covered by health insurance. ​​​​​​​We also have discount programs that offer exclusive savings on everything from auto, home, and pet insurance to low-interest personal loans. Work/Life Support We have several programs to support your work/life balance, including generous paid time off, back-up day care services, education assistance, and more. HEALTH & WELLNESS Medical Choices of medical plan to fit your needs that include two PPO and one high deductible health plan with competitive premiums are offered. All medical plans include prescription coverage with comprehensive access to a wide variety of medications. All oncology, Multiple Sclerosis drugs and fertility drugs manufactured by the company are available at no cost to covered participants under the PPO plan and at no cost to covered participants in the high deductible health plan after they meet their deductible. Additionally, all medical plans provide you and any covered dependents access to Well Connection, a convenient telehealth service. Dental & Vision Two dental plan choices both include orthodontia coverage (for adults and children) along with full vision coverage available. Virtual Primary Care ll medical plans provide you and any covered dependents access to Well Connection, a convenient telehealth service. Additionally, Firefly Health and Carbon Health offer virtual primary care, urgent care and mental health care with FREE visits when you have coverage under the medical plans (deductible will apply to high deductible health plan first). Wellness Program We have a wellness incentive program which provides up to a $500 annual benefit and access to a full library of classes, webinars, and other wellness activities. Personalized Health & Benefits Support You and your covered family members each have access to hands-on, personalized support to navigate your health and well-being benefits. This benefit will give you access to a health assistant who can help you choose the benefits that best meet your needs, add dependents to your plan, change your coverage, find in-network providers and so much more. Personalized Health Fitness and Weight Loss Reimbursement You can earn money for keeping healthy habits if you are enrolled in one of the three medical plan options. Employee Assistance Program We offer a free, confidential counseling and referral service to employees and family members. Live professional counselors are available 24/7 and include a highly qualified network of professionals. SAVINGS & FINANCIAL We offer various financial plans to help protect your financial future.401(k) 401(k) Savings and Investment plan Our 401(k) Plan provides a generous company-matching contribution and an additional discretionary contribution each year. Life and Accident Insurance The company automatically provides basic life insurance at no cost. Employees have the option to purchase additional life insurance for themselves plus coverage for dependents include spouse, domestic partners, and children. Tax Advantaged Accounts We offer different types of tax advantaged savings accounts to help pay for commuting costs, eligible healthcare expenses, and in some cases save money as well with a Health Savings Account (HSA) which include company contributions. Disability Coverage The company provides short-term disability at no cost due to illness or injury up to certain periods of time. Beyond that, long-term disability may be available and employees are automatically enrolled and may choose to buy-up for higher coverage. Personal Loan Program Access to low-cost, short-term loans to help when you need it. Quick and easy application process and payroll deduction repayment option while employed.
